about: The Gesar bard Drakpa Tharchin's short episode at the chang house at 19:30, before his main recital in Dechen-tsang's yard at 21:00 (chapter 05, NPC-27; chapter 04, 4.5). The hat's naming as part of the performance is general practice, unverified. His voice waits for a recording made with consent (chapter 10, 11.1): the refrain shows, the dranyen is heard.

lines.narrate: Drakpa Tharchin, the bard who lodges at Dechen-tsang, holds up his tall hat and names its parts to the room, one by one; then he puts it on, and his voice changes.
He sings of Ling for the length of a bowl of chang. Nobody drinks.

do: The bard Drakpa Tharchin sings a short episode at the chang house in the evening, before his long recital in Dechen-tsang's yard.
